prompt:
We're rolling out our OpenClaw AI assistant into the company's Feishu workspace for Nexus Consulting Group. The assistant needs to be properly configured so it can:

1. Know who is messaging it — both in group chats and in direct messages. Right now it has no idea who's sending DMs.
2. Behave appropriately in group conversations — not spam everyone, not stay silent when it should contribute.
3. Keep each person's private conversations completely separate from others — especially important since multiple staff and clients will use it.
4. Format its messages correctly for Feishu (our team has been complaining the messages look broken).
5. Stay up-to-date with new hires and contact changes automatically — we don't want to manually update this every week.

The config files are in `/workspace` (USER.md, AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, openclaw.json). The Feishu account name to use is `consultancy_bot_v2`. Please set everything up end-to-end so the agent is production-ready on Feishu.
